description: This file defines the ServiceMcaRule class which models a rule for mail condition-action processing within the OFBiz framework. It includes logic to parse XML configuration to initialize its conditions and actions, evaluate conditions against messages, and execute associated actions if conditions are met.

classes.name: ServiceMcaRule
classes.description: Represents a mail condition-action rule, capable of parsing its configuration from XML, evaluating conditions, and running actions based on message data.

methods.name: ServiceMcaRule
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rule from an XML element, extracting rule name, conditions, and actions.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates whether the conditions are met for a given message and user, then executes actions if conditions are true, updating actionsRun set.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the rule is enabled.
